name: Cyber Drak-Cool-Yas From Mars: Rat and Bat. Love and Hate.
source: A short story about Trixie Glimmer Smith, a rat on a quest to avoid writing her coursework report writing some thrilling self insert fanfiction set in the world of her favourite cartoon 'Cyber Drak-Cool-Yas from Mars'!
translation: 一部关于老鼠特里克茜·格利默·史密斯的短篇故事。为了逃避课程报告，她决定以自己最爱的动画《Cyber Drak-Cool-Yas from Mars》的世界为背景，写一篇惊险刺激、把自己也写进去的同人小说！
